title: DreamZero and matched VLA/WAM video evidence
claim_boundary: Publication-selected simulator clips are grouped by arena. DROID and RoboTwin success rates are never pooled. A clip is an evidence view, not an additional episode.
display_policy: Embed each canonical publication video once. Alternate square encodes, posters, captions, and FastWAM reconstruction inputs remain available through their source manifests but are not duplicated as additional evidence cards.

dreamzero_manifest_contract.note: The renderer ingests gallery_entries only after this manifest exists and every referenced video hash and byte count validates. Until then DreamZero remains visibly pending; no placeholder is interpreted as evidence.
